verses.en: O God, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.
verses.sm: Asafo. Le Atua e, ua 00 mai nuu ese i lou tofi; ua latou faaleagaina lou malumalu paia; ua latou faia Ierusalema ma faupuegámaa.

verses.en: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
verses.sm: Ua latou avatu tino o au auauna ua oti e fai ma mea e ‘ai a manu felelei, ua avatu tino O ou tagata amio Atua i manu feai e tataa.

verses.en: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.
verses.sm: Ua latou faamaligi o latou toto e pei o le vai, ua sco ai lerusalema; na leai foi se na te tanua i latou.

verses.en: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
verses.sm: Ua avea i matou ma gao a e ua matou tuaoi, o ulaga ma tauemuga a e ua vagavagai mai ia te i matou.

verses.en: How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
verses.sm: Le ALII e, e te toasa mai seia afea? e faavavau ea? e mu ea pei o le afi lou fua?

verses.en: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.
verses.sm: la e sasaaina atu lou toasa tele i nuu ese o e le iloa oe, atoa ma malo o e le valaau i lou suafa. Aua un latou ‘aina Iakopo,

verses.en: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.
verses.sm: o le mea foi sa nofo ai o ia ua latou faatafunaina lea. Aua e te manatua a matou agasala anamua;

verses.en: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.
verses.sm: ia vave ona tomua mai o lou alofa mutimuti vale ia te i matou; aua ua matuā vaivai i matou.

verses.en: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.
verses.sm: Le Atua o lo matou faaolataga e, ia e fesoasoani mai ia te i matou ona O lou suafa mamalu; ia e laveai mai foi ia te i matou,

verses.en: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.
verses.sm: ma ia e faamagaloina a matou agasala ona O lou suafa. 11 12 SALAMO 79, Se a le mea e fai ane ai o nuu ese, O ifea o ¡ai lo latou Atua? ia iloa i nuu ese o loo i o matou luma le taui o le toto o au auauna na faamaligiina.

verses.en: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;
verses.sm: Ja oo atu ia te oe le auega a le ua fusifusia; e tusa ma lou aao malosi ia e faasaoina e ua tuu e oti;

verses.en: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
verses.sm: ma ia e taui faafitu atu i fatafata o e ua matou tuaoi a latou upu na latou faifai ai ia te oe le Alii.

verses.en: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.
verses.sm: O i matou foi o lou nuu ma le lafu mamoe na e fagaina, matou te vivii ia te oe e faavavau; matou te ta‘uta‘u atu ou viiga i lea tupulaga ma lea tupulaga.
